alt: 夕陽貼近遠山，老舊水車停在乾涸溪流中，屋樑傾斜，年邁守屋人靜坐望著衰敗的磨坊。
scene_prompt: An old once-busy wooden watermill at dusk has nearly ceased operating: a cracked wheel hangs motionless in a nearly dry stream, roof beams sag, and a few brittle brown leaves cling to a dying tree. A frail elderly mill keeper sits quietly beside the closed mill, looking at its decay. The low sun touches the distant western hills, supporting the primary theme of an institution nearing its end, poignant not scenic holiday postcard. No signs or writing.
